responsibility: This machine option description file declares the GCC target options specific to OpenVMS and feeds the generated option tables. It defines switches such as -mmalloc64, -mdebug-main=, -mvms-return-codes, and -mpointer-size= together with the vms_pointer_size enum mapping, variable bindings, defaults, and help text, making it the source of truth for how VMS-specific command-line options are parsed into target flags.
same_name_distinction: Defines the OpenVMS-specific command-line option surface and generated option metadata: unlike vms.h, which sets compile-time target macros and hook wiring, and vms.cc, which executes VMS-specific code-generation behavior, this file is the declarative source for parsing options such as pointer-size, malloc64, debugger-main, and return-code mode into target variables and enums.
